scripts.dev: npm run build -w @skyhoof/game-core && npm run build -w @skyhoof/catalog && concurrently -n core,catalog,web,api -c green,blue,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @skyhoof/game-core" "npm run dev -w @skyhoof/catalog" "npm run dev -w @skyhoof/web" "npm run dev -w @skyhoof/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @skyhoof/game-core && npm run build -w @skyhoof/catalog && npm run build -w @skyhoof/api && npm run build -w @skyhoof/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
